about: The commands of the warm SolidWorks worker (scripts/swpanel_worker.py). One source of truth for the worker's dispatch, the swx.py client, the MCP server (mcp/server.py) and the tab's prompt; tests/test_contracts.py fails when any of them drifts from this file. Units: mm, mm2, mm3.

ping.summary: Is the worker up and connected to SolidWorks?

card.summary: Compact summary of the active model: globals, what drives what, components, patterns, named features, size, rebuild errors, and what changed since the last card of this file.

info.summary: Active document, the user's selection with its geometry (mm, part and assembly coordinates) and the part size.

args.name: --full
args.help: also the raw equations and the feature list

info.result: {doc, path, kind, unsaved_changes, config, selection[], size}

set.summary: Change global variables in place (as in Tools > Equations), rebuild and measure before / after.

args.name: assignments
args.help: one or more, e.g. WALL=3 HOLE_D=6.6

args.name: --selected
args.help: in the part / sub-assembly of the selected component

set.result: {doc, changed[{name, old, expr, new}], rebuild_errors, size_before, size_after, top_errors, saved}

fillet.summary: Fillet edges; the radius is driven by a new global variable so it can be edited later.

args.name: --edges
args.help: the selected edges, or every straight edge parallel to an axis

fillet.result: {feature, edges, radius_mm, global, dimension, rebuild_errors, size_before, size_after, saved}

save.summary: Save the active document (silent). A document that was never saved needs a script with save_as.

run.summary: Run a Python script in the warm worker. Names ready in the script: sw, doc, c (sw_common), swcad, PartBuilder, T.
